digest.component_or_area: Codex repository environment setup / AGENTS.md guidance
propositions: Codex sessions invoke ambient Ruff and miss mypy, unlike GitHub CI and Claude Code which use the repository environment.
AGENTS.md should instruct Codex sessions to bootstrap and activate the repository virtual environment before running development gates.
Guidance must prevent ambient Ruff or missing mypy from being mistaken for repository failures.
The change prepends the worktree .venv/bin to PATH per command, following docs/local-dev-env.md.
make lint and make typecheck must exit zero in a correctly provisioned worktree.
